items.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
items.blurb: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

items.title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash
items.blurb: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline. We’ve also lowered Clef-flash pricing and boosted Clef inference speeds by up to 2.0x.

items.title: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects
items.blurb: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.

items.title: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build
items.blurb: The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.
